answer.summary:
Fixed KAFKA-20434 by implementing a check in GroupMetadataManager.consumerGroupHeartbeat to detect when the group's preferred server-side assignor changes and bump the group epoch accordingly. When a member updates their server assignor preference, the code now compares the current preferred assignor with what it would be after the member update. If the preferred assignor changes, the group epoch is bumped to trigger recomputation of the target assignment with the new assignor. This ensures that when static members rejoin with a different server-side assignor (e.g., uniform to range), and the majority preference shifts, the assignment is recomputed. The fix only applies when: (1) regex is not pending resolution, (2) the member's assignor changed, (3) there are already members with assignors in the group. All tests pass including the new testStaticMembersRejoinWithNewServerAssignor test.</parameter>
